_note: Candidate registry for Connecticut 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Connecticut Secretary of the State, November 3, 2026, State Election, Sample Town Ballots (official party-row ballots posted by the Secretary of the State), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Connecticut Secretary of the State, November 3, 2026, State Election, Sample Town Ballots (official party-row ballots posted by the Secretary of the State) (https://portal.ct.gov/sots/election-services/town-ballots/2026-november-town-election-ballots); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
